Subject: Feature enablement onboarding: streaming + function/tool-calling / Acme Health

Hi team —

Thanks for partnering with Redwood. Quick handoff: Acme Health is focused on enabling two features for their clinician-facing workflow this quarter: low-latency streaming responses for triage summaries, and deterministic function/tool calling for EMR lookups with strictly structured outputs (they want JSON schemas for downstream ingestion).

Marissa — you're the CS lead on this account. Dev, Vivek — this will be your technical pairing for the kickoff. Laura, I'm looping you in as the sales manager for visibility on timings and any contract items if they request an accelerated timeline.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical kickoff: Wed Mar 10 (45 min) — review streaming patterns, schema contracts, and function calling examples.
- Dev to share a draft JSON schema and ask for a small sample payload from Acme before the call.
- Marissa to own onboarding checklist and schedule recurring enablement sessions.

Attachments: acme_pre_kickoff_questions.pdf (PDF) — short questionnaire for the customer to fill out before the kickoff.

Marissa, can you coordinate the calendar invite and capture a 3-item pre-kickoff checklist?

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attach: acme_pre_kickoff_questions.pdf

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acmehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feature enablement onboarding: streaming + function/tool-calling / Acme Health

Hi Aisha / Marissa / Dev —

Appreciate the handoff. We're excited to get streaming in place for the clinician triage view — latency is a hard requirement (sub-200ms token delivery preferred). For function/tool calling, we need the agent to return a fixed JSON object with the following constraints:
- top-level keys: patient_id, action, payload
- payload must validate against a provided schema (we can accept draft-07)

We filled out most of the pre-kickoff questionnaire and attached it to this thread (see answers inline).

Availability: Wed Mar 10, 10:00–12:00 PT or 14:00–16:00 PT. Either slot works; prefer the earlier one.

Two asks for the kickoff prep:
1) Can Dev share an initial JSON schema draft for the streaming message envelope?
2) We will provide a small set of sample payloads (redacted PHI) by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Director of Engineering, Integrations | Acme Health
attach: acme_pre_kickoff_questions_answers.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feature enablement onboarding: streaming + function/tool-calling / Acme Health

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick responses and the availability — Wed 10:00 PT is confirmed from our side. Attached is a first-pass schema for the streaming envelope and a short tech note on how we expose function/tool calling with strict output enforcement. Highlights:
- Streaming envelope (acme_streaming_schema_v1.json): fields for chunk_index, is_final, trace_id, model_meta, and a payload field that should conform to your downstream schema. We recommend including sequence numbers to support reordering tolerance.
- Function calling: we support explicit function signatures; Redwood can enforce the returned JSON against a provided JSON Schema and fail the call (with a deterministic error) if validation fails — this prevents malformed objects from hitting your ingestion pipeline.
- Implementation plan: 1) validate sample payloads against draft schema, 2) enable a staging integration with token-level logging, 3) monitor quality regression for the first 48 hours post-launch.

Attachments: acme_streaming_schema_v1.json (application/json), redwood_technical_kickoff_agenda.md (text)

Could you upload the sample payloads to the Drive link below so I can run local validation before the call?
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_kickoff_docs

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
